description.value:
You wrench three piles of loose debris or small objects off the ground and launch them at your foes. Choose a creature you can see within range for each pile; every pile automatically deals 1d4+1 force damage to its target, striking simultaneously, and you may split the piles among one or several creatures.

Force Potency. Cast with a force slot of 2nd level or higher, you hurl one additional pile of debris for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 1
